en.title: Wulong Karst: Three Natural Bridges, Tickets & Day Trip
en.headline: Wulong Karst from Chongqing: The Three Natural Bridges, the Fissure Gorge and Whether to Stay the Night
en.description: Wulong's Three Natural Bridges span a gorge in a UNESCO karst area and starred in Transformers. Opening hours by season, what the ticket covers and how to get there.
en.heroAlt: Sheer limestone cliffs above a green pool and a visitor walkway in Wulong's karst gorge

zh.title: 武隆天生三桥攻略：开放时间、门票与一日游
zh.headline: 从重庆去武隆：天生三桥、龙水峡地缝，以及要不要住一晚
zh.description: 武隆天生三桥横跨峡谷，属世界遗产“中国南方喀斯特”，也是《变形金刚4》取景地。各季开放时间、门票包含什么、怎么去。
zh.heroAlt: 武隆喀斯特峡谷中陡峭的石灰岩崖壁、碧绿水潭和游客步道

ko.title: 우롱 카르스트: 천생삼교, 입장권, 충칭 당일치기

ko.heroAlt: 우롱 카르스트 협곡의 깎아지른 석회암 절벽과 초록 웅덩이, 관람 데크
